history.summary: CSV row 150 ('Shiv Mandir') is a generic name shared by several shrines in Purnia, so this identification is provisional. It is documented here as the Shiv Mandir at Khajanchi Hat-Line Bazar, Madhopara, Purnia (geocoder POI match at the given coordinates; listed on onefivenine and yappe.in). One visitor review describes this Line Bazar complex as a city temple whose main shrine is to Goddess Durga, with additional shrines to Shiva, Hanuman and Radha-Krishna. No reliable source gives its founding date or builder. Nearby shrines carrying the same generic name include Baba Purneshwar Mahadev Mandir (Pratap Colony) and Ugna Shiv Mandir (Maithil Tola).

name: Shiv Mandir
town_description: Purnia (also Purnea) is a city in northeastern Bihar and the headquarters of Purnia district and division. An educational and commercial hub of the Seemanchal-Kosi region, it is nicknamed 'Mini Darjeeling' and takes its name from goddess Puran Devi (Puran Aranya).

travel.airport: Nearest commercial airport: Bagdogra (IXB), about 160-170 km by road; Purnia's own airport is under development.
travel.railway: Purnea Junction, a major railhead on the Katihar-Samastipur section, lies within the city.
travel.road: NH 27 and NH 31 pass through Purnia; well connected by bus, auto-rickshaw and taxi.
